DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.ddg.qov.ph OPINION NO. S. DEC DIRECTOR HECTOR L. CORTES Officer-in-charge Commission on Audit — Regional Office II Tuguegarao City, Cagayan Dear Director Cortes: This pertains to your letter dated October 12, 2023 forwarding to the Department the Memorandum dated October 1 1, 2023 from Atty. Frederick R. Barillo, Attorney IV/OIC- Supervising Auditor, Local Government Audit Sector Cluster B — Cagayan Province, seeking legal opinion relative to the issue on the maximum amount of bond required of a Barangay Treasurer pursuant to Section 395(d) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC). Section 395(d) of the LGC is explicit, thus: Section 395. Barangay Treasurer: Appointment, Qualification, Powers and Duties. xxx (d) The barangay treasurer shall be bonded in accordance with existing laws in an amount to be determined by the sangguniang barangay but not exceeding Ten thousand pesos (PI 0,000.00), premiums for which shall be paid by the barangay. While the Department concurs with the observation of the Commission on Audit that the maximum amount of bond provided above is already impractical and does not address the needs of Barangays, we regret to inform you that we cannot provide a solution, i.e. increase the maximum bond of barangay treasurer, as the law is explicit. This issue, we believe, requires an amendment of the relevant provision/s of the LGC. We shall take your recommendation into account and make a manifestation on this matter with the legislative branch of the government, for possible amendment of the LGC. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: . JUAN VICTOR R.
